mapper.select: SELECT bo.id AS order_id, bo.order_no, bo.user_id, su.username, bo.room_id, hr.room_no, bo.bed_id, hb.bed_no, bo.check_in_date, bo.check_out_date, bo.order_status, bo.amount, bo.pay_time, bo.assign_time, bo.remark FROM booking_order bo LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = bo.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hostel_room hr ON hr.id = bo.room_id AND hr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hostel_bed hb ON hb.id = bo.bed_id AND hb.deleted = 0 WHERE bo.deleted = 0 AND bo.id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT bo.id AS order_id, bo.order_no, bo.user_id, su.username, bo.room_id, hr.room_no, bo.bed_id, hb.bed_no, bo.check_in_date, bo.check_out_date, bo.order_status, bo.amount, bo.pay_time, bo.assign_time, bo.remark FROM booking_order bo LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = bo.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hostel_room hr ON hr.id = bo.room_id AND hr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hostel_bed hb ON hb.id = bo.bed_id AND hb.deleted = 0 WHERE bo.deleted = 0 AND bo.order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
